doc: Field movement tuning (M1-ARC-01). Metres, seconds, degrees. Read by FieldMotor/FieldController. run_speed_mps matches the heroes' jog clip's own ground speed within 2% (characters' b344b974: a 2.6 m stride at 164 steps a minute, game/data/characters/locomotion.json run.speed_mps 3.545), so the feet plant at playback 1.02 (the Lead, 10-30: from the clip, within 2.3-3.6 m/s). 3.55 was tried: Coilspire's spiral walk then put Toma in the steps for 50 frames (test_qa_walk_audit), so the run stays 3.6, inside the 2%.

input_latch.doc: Camera-relative input keeps the pre-change camera's reference across a shot change until the stick is released (genre convention for fixed cameras). release_on_turn_deg > 0 also releases the latch when the stick turns more than that from its direction at the change.

shore.doc: FieldShore (the human's playtest: on Oruvel's dock town you could step off a deck and walk in the sea). Over ground under a zone WaterSurface by more than wade_m, a step is refused (he stays at the edge, as at a wall) when the ground drops more than edge_drop_m from where he stood (a dock, pier or hull edge), or lies more than deep_water_m under the surface and deeper than where he stood (walking back out is always allowed). Grounded deeper than deep_water_m anyway, he is put back on his last safe spot if it is within teleport_m (else a spawn or teleport put him there, and the old spot is forgotten). Standing more than underwater_m under the surface, he walks the seabed (Oruvel's underway) or under a surface (Lowlight's drowned Sanctum): no shore rule and no catch. The ground is found by a ray from probe_up_m above to probe_down_m below; a spot where the ray finds no ground is not judged (a ray that starts inside a terrain collider misses it).
